1360.0.0.description:
Log TestSuite PostRun failure for results publishing

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the test-suite post-run outcome for results publishing. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1360.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1360.1001.1.description:
Configure BFD links between devices and check it comes up

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies basic single-hop BFD session establishment between two devices. Configures a BFD-monitored link on each peer and confirms the BFD session negotiates and comes up to the operational/Up state on both ends.

1360.1001.2.description:
Configure BFD links between devices and check bfd detects port down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD fault detection on physical link loss. With a BFD session up, brings the monitored port down and confirms BFD on both the local and remote device promptly detects the link failure and moves the session out of the Up state.

1360.1001.3.description:
Configure BFD links between devices and test negotiation is succesful for differing intervals

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD timer negotiation between peers configured with differing intervals. Confirms the session still comes up and the negotiated transmit/receive intervals resolve to the slower (highest) of the two peers' configured values, as required by the protocol.

1360.1001.4.description:
Configure BFD links between devices and check if negotiated interval is same as the configured non-default values

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD timer negotiation with explicit non-default intervals. Configures matching non-default transmit/receive intervals on both peers and confirms the negotiated operating intervals equal the configured non-default values.

1360.1001.5.description:
Configure BFD links between devices and check if remote multiplier change is detected locally after negotiation

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies local detection of a remote BFD detect-multiplier change. After the session is established, changes the multiplier on the remote peer and confirms the local device sees the updated remote multiplier value carried in the negotiated session state.

1360.1002.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1360.1002.1.description:
Configure BFD links between devices and check BFD detects MISMATCH condition

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD MISMATCH detection. Configures the peers so their BFD parameters do not agree and confirms the device correctly reports the BFD session in the MISMATCH state rather than coming up.

1360.1002.2.description:
Configure BFD link between devices passing through a L2 switch and confirm it operates correctly

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD operates correctly across an intervening L2 switch. Builds a BFD session between two routers whose link transits a transparent L2 switch and confirms the session negotiates and reaches the operational state end to end.

1360.1002.3.description:
Configure BFD link between devices passing through a L2 switch and use ACL to block BFD frames on L2 switch and check BFD detects the broken link connectivity

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD detects loss of forwarding when the path is broken at an intermediate L2 switch. With a BFD session up through the L2 switch, applies an ACL on the switch to drop BFD frames in both directions and confirms both local and remote BFD detect the broken link connectivity.

1360.1002.4.description:
Configure BFD link between devices passing through a L2 switch and use ACL to block Unidirectional BFD frames on L2 switch and check if RSTP changes port state to DISCARDING

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD-driven RSTP reconvergence when BFD frames are blocked in one direction. Applies an ACL on the intervening L2 switch to drop unidirectional BFD frames and confirms BFD declares the link FAULT and the affected RSTP port transitions to the DISCARDING state.

1360.1002.5.description:
Configure BFD link between devices passing through a L2 switch and use ACL to block Bidirectional BFD frames on L2 switch and check if RSTP changes port state to DISCARDING

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD-driven RSTP reconvergence when BFD frames are blocked in both directions. Applies an ACL on the L2 switch to drop bidirectional BFD frames and confirms BFD detects the fault and RSTP moves the affected port to the DISCARDING state.

1360.1003.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1360.1003.1.description:
Enable BFD service and check BFD peers are detected and BFD status is operational

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies the BFD service brings up directly configured L3 BFD peers. Enables the BFD service on both devices and confirms the configured BFD peers are detected and the session reaches the operational/Up state.

1360.1003.2.description:
Configure BFD service and verify link down event is detected by BFD

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies link-down detection for a BFD service peer. With the BFD service session up, takes the monitored link down and confirms BFD detects the down event and updates peer state accordingly.

1360.1003.3.description:
Configure BFD service on 2 devices, disable BFD service on one and verify remote device detects peer as down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies remote-side detection when the BFD service is administratively disabled on the peer. Disables the BFD service on one device and confirms the remote device detects the peer transitioning to down.

1360.1003.4.description:
Configure BFD service on 2 devices, configure bfd L3 peer, enable/disable them from configs and ensure BFD works and no crashes are observed

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies stability of L3 BFD peers under repeated administrative enable/disable. Configures BFD L3 peers on two devices and repeatedly enables and disables them from configuration, confirming BFD continues to operate correctly with no crashes or exceptions.

1360.1003.5.description:
Configure BFD and BGP with BFD fallback between 2 devices, Verify BGP peer state gets updated based on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BGP-over-BFD fast fallover. Configures BGP with BFD fallback between two devices, brings the monitored link down and confirms BFD detects the failure and drives the BGP neighbour out of ESTABLISHED, then confirms both BFD and the BGP session recover when the link is restored.

1360.1003.6.description:
Enable BFD service with echo mode enabled check BFD peers are detected and BFD status is operational

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BFD service operation with echo mode enabled. Enables the BFD service with echo mode and confirms the BFD peers are detected and the session reaches the operational state.

1360.1003.7.description:
Configure BFD service with echo-mode and verify link down event is detected by BFD

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies link-down detection for a BFD service peer running in echo mode. With an echo-mode session up, takes the link down and confirms BFD detects the down event.

1360.1003.8.description:
Configure BFD in echo mode and BGP between 2 devices, Verify BGP peer state gets updated based on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BGP fallover driven by an echo-mode BFD session. Configures BFD echo mode plus BGP between two devices, brings the link down and confirms BFD reports the remote peer down and BGP leaves ESTABLISHED, then confirms both recover when the link returns.

1360.1003.9.description:
BGP with BFD using a BFD profile, verify BGP peer state gets updated based on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BGP fallover using a named BFD profile. Associates BGP with a BFD profile, brings the monitored link up/down and confirms the BGP peer state tracks the BFD session state.

1360.1003.10.description:
Configuring custom BFD intervals using a BFD profile with BGP

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies that custom BFD intervals supplied via a BFD profile are applied to a BGP-associated session. Confirms both devices have BGP and BFD set up and that the configured receive, transmit and echo intervals from the profile are in effect.

1360.1003.11.description:
OSPF with BFD on all interfaces with a BFD profile, verify OSPF peer state gets updated based on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies OSPF fallover with BFD applied to all interfaces via a BFD profile. Confirms BFD comes up and OSPF reaches Full, then brings a link down and confirms BFD and the OSPF neighbour state update, recovering to Full when the link is restored.

1360.1003.12.description:
OSPF with BFD on all interfaces with a BFD profile - including a virtual link, verify OSPF peer state and virtual link status

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies OSPF-with-BFD operation across an OSPF virtual link. Applies a BFD profile to all interfaces including a virtual link, confirms the BFD peer and the OSPF virtual link are up, then takes the link down and confirms both the BFD peer and the virtual link go down and recover correctly.

1360.1003.13.description:
Configuring custom BFD intervals using a BFD profile with OSPF

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies custom BFD intervals supplied via a BFD profile are applied to an OSPF-associated session, with OSPF/BFD tracking link up/down events.

1360.1003.14.description:
OSPF with BFD on a singular interface

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies OSPF-with-BFD applied to a single interface (rather than all interfaces). Confirms BFD comes up, OSPF reaches Full, and that OSPF neighbour state tracks the BFD session as the link is taken down and restored.

1360.1003.15.description:
Static routes with BFD on all interfaces with a BFD profile, verify peer state gets updated based on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies static routing with BFD applied to all interfaces via a BFD profile. Confirms the BFD peer comes up and static routes are present, then brings the link down/up and confirms BFD and route state track the link. On the analysed run the functional BFD/route assertions passed but the run was marked FAIL by a known stacking configuration-sync caveat (the 'ip route bfd all-interfaces profile' command not propagating to all stack members), not a BFD functional defect.

1360.1003.16.description:
Static route with BFD on a singular interface

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies static routing with BFD applied to a single interface. Confirms the BFD peer is operational and static routes are correct, then takes the link down and confirms BFD detects it and recovers when the link is restored.

1360.1003.17.description:
Static route with BFD on a singular route

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies static routing with BFD applied to a single static route (fall-over per route). Confirms the BFD peer is operational and the static route is correct, then brings the link down/up and confirms BFD and the route track the link state.

1360.1003.50.description:
Configure BFD and BGP with BFD fallback between 2 devices, Verify BGP peer state gets updated based on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies BGP-over-BFD fallover (variant configuration). Configures BGP with BFD fallback between two devices and confirms the BGP peer state is updated as the monitored link goes down and comes back up.

1360.1003.110.description:
OSPF with BFD on all interfaces with a BFD profile, verify OSPF peer state gets updated based on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies OSPF fallover with BFD on all interfaces via a BFD profile (variant configuration). Confirms BFD and OSPF come up and that the OSPF neighbour state tracks the BFD session as the link is taken down and restored.

1360.1004.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1360.1004.1.description:
Configure a single hop BFD-VRF connection, verify peer state is updated on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies single-hop BFD over a VRF. Configures a single-hop BFD session within a VRF and confirms the BFD peer state tracks link up/down events.

1360.1004.2.description:
Configure a multihop BFD-VRF connection, verify peer state is updated on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies multihop BFD over a VRF. Configures a multihop BFD session within a VRF and confirms the peer comes up and tracks link down and recovery.

1360.1004.3.description:
Configure a single hop BFD-VRF-BGP connection, verify BGP and BFD peer state is updated on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies single-hop BFD with BGP inside a VRF. Confirms the BGP and BFD peers come up and that both update correctly as the monitored link goes down and recovers.

1360.1004.4.description:
Configure a multihop BFD-VRF-BGP connection, verify BGP and BFD peer state is updated on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies multihop BFD with BGP inside a VRF. Confirms the multihop BGP/BFD peers come up and that both update correctly on link up/down.

1360.1004.5.description:
Configure a BFD-VRF-IPv4 Static Route using fall-over bfd command, verify BFD peer state is updated on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies a VRF IPv4 static route protected by BFD using the 'fall-over bfd' command. Confirms the BFD peer is operational and the static route is correct, and that BFD and the route track link down/recovery.

1360.1004.6.description:
Configure a BFD-VRF-OSPF connection, verify BFD/OSPF peer state is updated on link up/down

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies OSPF with BFD inside a VRF. Confirms BFD and OSPF come up (neighbour Full), then takes the link down and confirms both BFD and the OSPF neighbour state update and recover when the link is restored.

1360.1004.7.description:
Changing BFD multihop to single hop

[Log-derived analysis] Verifies converting a BFD session from multihop to single-hop. Confirms BFD is operational in multihop mode and, after reconfiguration, that it is operational in single-hop mode.
